def can_bob_win(n, ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy):
    # Check if the target is in the same row, column, or diagonal as the queen
    if ax == bx or ay == by or abs(ax - bx) == abs(ay - by):
        return "NO"
    
    # Check if the king can move to the target without crossing the queen's control
    if bx <= cx and bx + (cx - bx) <= n and by <= cy and by + (cy - by) <= n:
        return "YES"
    if bx >= cx and bx - (bx - cx) >= 1 and by <= cy and by + (cy - by) <= n:
        return "YES"
    if bx <= cx and bx + (cx - bx) <= n and by >= cy and by - (by - cy) >= 1:
        return "YES"
    if bx >= cx and bx - (bx - cx) >= 1 and by >= cy and by - (by - cy) >= 1:
        return "YES"
    
    return "NO"
